2025
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao

entities.text: Bobburi Chaitanya vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition has been filed seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR. No.183 of 2016, dated 05.12.2016 on the file of Station House Officer, Mahabubabad(R) Police Station, Mahabubabad District, wherein the petitioner was arrayed as accused No.1, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273 read with 34 Indian Penal Code ('IPC' for brevity).
2.

Heard Sri M.Achyuth Reddy, learned counsel, representing Sri N.Avaneesh, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri B.Sridhar, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 2.
3.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home submits that during the pendency of this writ petition, respondent No.2 after conducting investigation transferred the crime to Food Safety Officer, Warangal and the said authority after conducting investigation filed final report before II Additional Junior Civil Judge, Mahabubabad District and the said Court has taken cognizance and the same was numbered as C.C.No.635 of 2019 and JSR, J W.P.No.22504 OF 2017 the same is pending.

entities.text: II Additional Junior Civil Judge, Mahabubabad District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By virtue of the same, cause in the present writ petition does not survive for further adjudication.

4. Taking into consideration the above said submissions, the petitioner is granted liberty to avail the remedies as available under law, if so, he is aggrieved, seeking quash of C.C.No.635 of 2019 by raising all the grounds which are available under law.
5. With the above observations, this writ petition is disposed of accordingly.

Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
______________________ J. SREENIVAS RAO, J Date: 24.09.2025 PSW Bobburi Chaitanya vs The State Of Telangana, on 24 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179923677/
